SMPD_PS for ACM_RFI# 528310 - Master Equipment Supply Agreement
notices.description:
The New York City Housing Authoritys (NYCHA) Asset and Capital Management Division is seeking input (Responses) from manufacturers and suppliers of auger compactors and interior compactors on a proposed Master Equipment Supply Agreement.

 

Under this new procurement approach, NYCHA would enter into an agreement with a qualified manufacturer or supplier, establishing pre-negotiated terms, conditions, and unit pricing for equipment to be supplied across multiple NYCHA developments. NYCHAs project-specific installation contractors would issue Purchase Orders against the agreement as equipment is needed, while payment obligations to the supplier would remain with NYCHA.

This RFI is available online through NYCHAs Oracle iSupplier system (iSupplier). Instructions for registering for iSupplier can be found at  http://www1.nyc.gov/site/nycha/business/vendors.page.

notices.short_title: Systemwide Commissioning Services
notices.description:
NYC Health & Hospitals requests proposals for facility commissioning services related to new construction, facility renovations, re-commissioning of existing systems, or facility system assessments throughout its portfolio of buildings. The types of facilities to be commissioned may include office/administration, hospitals, health clinics, laboratories, or combinations thereof.

Commissioning is a systematic quality-assurance process used to verify and document that building systems and components are designed, installed, tested, started, operated, and maintained in accordance with NYC Health & Hospitals Project Requirements, Basis of Design, contract documents, and applicable performance criteria. The commissioning process shall confirm, prior to Substantial Completion and Owner acceptance, that the systems are complete and functioning as intended and that NYC Health & Hospitals facility staff have received adequate operating documentation and training…

notices.description:
Pursuant to Section 3-05 of the NYC Procurement Policy Board Rules, it is the intent of the New York City Police Department (NYPD), to enter into sole source negotiations with Mark Andy, Inc, located at PO Box 300, 1 Riverside Avenue, Somerset, Massachusetts 02726.

NYPD has determined that Mark Andy Inc is the sole source vendor for Mark Andy Inc printing press equipment and maintenance services because Mark Andy Inc is the only authorized vendor that has necessary training certifications and authorized technicians to service the Presstek printing press equipments to make the necessary repairs, services and installations.
